segments.en: I am working in construction, I am 35 years old. What about you?
My hometown is Kollam, I am currently in Coimbatore.
I said I am married. You are not married, right?
No, no. Why did you say that?
Nothing, it's just that when girls of your age come, we ask if they are married. I say I am married and have two children.
Then why this app, I ask.
Just to talk, to pass time.
How long have you been using this app?
I have been using it for one year and two months.
Yes, I use it often. Two or three hours a day.
Yes, I use it when I go to work. When I go to the work site, I call. Girls of your age come, good age, 40, 48, 49 years old ladies have come.
There is nothing like age being high or low.
Inside it, there are many clearing, small kids.
They already ask us directly, they say video call.
Others, if they need financial help, I will give.
A lady came, she is from Bangalore. I have been in Nagercoil for 14 days, I came to my friend's house.
Like that, I talked to her. I talked for a long time. Then she asked me, 'Can you come?' I said, 'I don't even have money for petrol.'
I said, 'I can only come in my car, I have to fill petrol.'
I said, 'I will give you money for petrol, but you have to stand with me for two days.'
I said, 'I gave money, but what is the point of taking a lady?'
I have not taken any lady after I got married.
Before, ladies of that age used to go.
A 35-year-old lady went, when I was 22 and a half.
Men, men generally like ladies of higher age.
I didn't hear, it's not time to eat food. It's 4 o'clock in the evening, I drank tea, ate snacks.
Onam, okay. Waiting. How was Onam?
Onam was amazing. How long have you been using this app?
I have been using it for two weeks, two weeks.
Your age, how is this app?
It's okay, it's good. There is no problem.
Then, when they come to you, they ask for open talk, right?
That is a common thing. Open talk, I have asked small ladies for open talk.
When they ask me, we talk about open talk, they, they don't know open talk. Open is not known.
Open talk means we already, now I usually ask open talk, we talk to some ladies, talk openly. Open talk is not what I mean.
So they, this coming, open talk, they talk about sex. But they don't know sex.
Did you understand? People of your age, then some people live in Bangalore, some say they have friends, we used to have sex, we know everything, we can do it.
But they, when we talk to them, we know they don't know anything.
A lady told me, 'I will do sex with my friend.' I said, 'Do it.' I said, 'If you have menstruation, do it after that.'
Then I understood that it is a lie. That is just to pass time.
I know, I heard it from somewhere, we know that we won't do it at that time.
11, 11 days, 9 days, it won't be done. If it is done, you are young, so it will be done quickly.
If they are of age, at that time they know what to do to avoid it.
Is there any problem talking like this?
